properties.description: REGISTRY (empty), the one place a deprecation is declared: item, deprecated_in, what_to_do, decision. mark_tools puts "DEPRECATED in <version>, removed in the next release: <what to do>" on a deprecated tool's, argument's or reply field's description; mark_vocabulary and listing mark describe_schema; used_by decides which deprecated items a call uses (shared with the surface check) and attach_notice adds `deprecation_notice`; removed_tool is a removed tool's one-release stub refusal; validate and changelog_problems are the registry's own checks. Every function is the identity on an empty registry.
properties.name: deprecation.rs — the retirement rule: the one registry of deprecations, the mark, the notice, the tool stub and the changelog check
